verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an expense-management SaaS that stores receipts and financial data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents retention settings, deletion of receipts or accounts, or API-based data purging. The community reports about SmartScan receipts being seen by human workers concern data handling, not retention or deletion controls, and do not establish the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
